name: align-center
description: A centered square with separated horizontal and vertical axes.
useCase: Center an object on both axes.
misuse: Do not confuse this action with text alignment or a fixed grid position.

16.reason: The square and four guide marks share the exact center, with equal one-pixel painted gaps.

24.reason: The square and four guide marks share the exact center, with equal 1.5-pixel painted gaps.
